work_handoff.title: N21｜Cohort Enters — Scale Reveal｜Candidate 01
requirements: Generate exactly one N21 Candidate 01 and stop for Product Owner review.
9:16 vertical cinematic audio-comic still.
Primary read must be the full participant cohort actively entering the castle; N21 is a group-scale reveal, not a named-character showcase.
Story truth: sixteen participants total; men and women are evenly split at this story point.

Do not force sixteen equally clear faces or full bodies. Prefer approximately 4–6 comparatively readable figures and let the remaining participants be smaller, rear-facing, side-facing, partially cropped, partially occluded, or deeper in shadow.
If every person is fully countable, total must be exactly 16. If natural overlap or cropping prevents exact counting, the frame must still plausibly read as the complete sixteen-person cohort.
Maintain one global movement direction from castle entrance toward the interior, with local asynchrony in gait, body angle, spacing and progress.
Crowd movement must feel like real people filtering inward. Avoid synchronized strides, repeated walking poses, rows, military formation, class-photo staging or publicity-photo staging.
Use natural depth, overlap and occlusion when useful. Do not force a fixed foreground/midground/background template if another composition better serves the approved node function.
Limit clear frontal faces where possible. Reduce exposed complex hand gestures and avoid requiring every participant's hands and feet to be simultaneously readable.

Ning Qiushui and Jun Luyuan remain continuity figures from N20 but are secondary within the cohort. Preserve their current appearance and wardrobe without recreating a hero two-shot or the exact N20 pose.
Su Xiaoxiao, Liao Jian, Wen Qingya and Guang Yong have no formal identity-seeding task in N21. Do not arrange or emphasize them for recognition.
Neil must not appear as one of the sixteen participants.
All participants should look like ordinary living people at this moment; no spectral, transparent, undead or glowing ghost styling.
Scene remains CASTLE_ENTRANCE → INTERIOR TRANSITION ZONE. Do not establish the full First Hall.
AST_IMG_000052 controls castle-entrance architecture, materials and open-door state, but does not control exact camera angle or empty-scene composition.
N20 controls immediate visual continuity, Ning/Jun appearance, wardrobe, and the warm low-key visual baseline, but does not control exact camera, pose or two-person dominance.
Color/look must clearly continue N20: warm low-key interior, natural skin, restrained saturation, readable dark texture, moderate cinematic contrast and broadly continuous light direction.
The entrance may be somewhat brighter and cooler/neutral, but exterior brightness must remain localized near the doorway and must not flood the whole interior.
Director acceptance priority: first read = full cohort entering; clear scale expansion from N20; natural crowd motion; controlled multi-person complexity; N20 color/world continuity.
